links.outcome: Patient satisfaction and expert ratings of chatbot and robot interviews versus psychiatrist-led interviews
links.effect: Psychiatrist-led interviews had higher satisfaction, especially communication quality; willingness to repeat did not differ; expert ratings comparable across modalities except alignment with other assessment methods favoring psychiatrists over robot.
links.quote: Psychiatrist-led interviews achieved higher satisfaction scores, particularly for communication quality, while willingness to repeat screening did not differ significantly across modalities.

unlisted_practices: Content validation of AI screening interview questions by experts for relevance and clarity
Personality traits predicting patient satisfaction with technology-mediated interviews

screen.reason: The study conducts a randomized controlled trial testing chatbot and humanoid robot conversational screening interviews against human psychiatrist interviews in 106 young mental health patients.
